title: NANSEN dev binary stack
description: NANSEN dev's own image stack file: a headerless .raw (or .bin, .dat) beside an .ini with its Size and Class, in MATLAB's column-major order, little-endian, as dev's motion correction and downsampling wrote them. A .raw whose .ini is SciScan's is read as SciScan's, so every .raw of a dev project is read. Read a chunk of frames at a time, and written in the same format.
